answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond. Each agent locks 100 tokens to register, and provable cheating is slashed on-ledger. Faking 1,000 sybils means posting 1,000 separate bonds — 100,000 tokens at risk, not a free signature dashed off with a quill. A fresh sybil is hollow: it holds no real stake, so the capital delta between one honest agent and a thousand fakes becomes the defensive wall, and slashing makes every extra identity cost real money.
